title: Real Authority B source-stop experiment
source_model: B script source emits no command for the exact target ticks in each source_stop segment; B remains bound and the session remains active.
not_claimed: real network disconnect or wire ACK failure
stop_rule: Wait for ScriptComplete, require the final accepted B target tick to have an effective B availability row, require one additional committed Authority boundary, then send stop once through controller stdin. Trailing post-script silence is outside the four scheduled windows.
a_action: Operator through the authorized physical keyboard tool: bounded W/D/S/A center-square movement around the start room, begun before a delayed controller start; Resolve state and available Player positions in complete-or-explicitly-partial world samples are recorded.
world_record: min-read-v1 is enabled so the same run provides A/B Player position fields with explicit complete/partial/reason status and the 70-slot restoration transaction. No incomplete sample is promoted to a complete world snapshot.
check_boundary: A single controller session/run and one analysis invocation; no retry.
expected_effective_missing_reason_shape: For each gap: NoTargetCommand for all but the final effective missing tick; FutureOnly on the final tick because the resumed command is already queued during that tick. A one-tick gap therefore has one FutureOnly tick.
